en.headline: Remand prisoner attacks staff at Tai Lam Centre for Women; both injured
en.dek: A 35-year-old woman held on remand for possessing Part I poison allegedly assaulted a correctional officer in a reception room on Monday afternoon; both were taken to hospital.
body: The Correctional Services Department said a 35-year-old female remand prisoner at Tai Lam Centre for Women suddenly became emotional and attacked a staff member in a reception room at about 2.15 pm on Monday.

Officers on the scene restrained the woman and summoned support. The correctional officer suffered injuries to the forearm and fingers, while the prisoner injured her wrist. Both were examined by the institution’s doctor and later sent to a public hospital for further treatment.
The department said the case has been referred to police for investigation. The woman had been remanded this year for possession of a Part I poison.

zh.headline: 大欖女懲教所還押女子襲擊職員 雙方受傷送院
zh.dek: 一名35歲因管有第I部毒藥罪還押的女子周一在收押室突然情緒失控襲擊懲教人員，雙方均受傷送院。
body: 懲教署表示，大欖女懲教所周一約下午2時15分，一名35歲女性還押在囚人士在收押室內突然情緒失控，襲擊一名懲教人員。
在場懲教人員立即制止施襲者並召喚支援。事件中，一名懲教人員前臂及手指受傷，施襲者則手腕受傷。經院所醫生檢查及治理後，兩人均被送往公立醫院作進一步診治。
有關事件已轉交警方調查。施襲者於今年因管有第I部毒藥罪而被還押。
